posts.text: I’m thrilled to see that SpaceX and Tesla have made #TX10 the destination for their >$100 billion investment into domestic chip manufacturing. Terafab will bolster national security, create over 3,000 jobs for local residents, and ensure the future is Made in America — not China.
posts.summary: Praises SpaceX/Tesla chip investment, emphasizes domestic manufacturing and national security

posts.text:
A fierce champion for the Lone Star State, Kay Granger broke through barriers to pave the way for generations of conservative women in Texas politics. In the halls of Congress, she wielded her appropriations gavel with grace and resolve, gaining the respect of members across the political spectrum.

She was a principled stateswoman, a steadfast defender of U.S. national security, and a friend who will be deeply missed. Please join me in praying for her loved ones during this time.
posts.summary: Praises Kay Granger's conservative leadership and appropriations work
